statusLine.command: input=$(cat); CYAN=$(printf '\033[96m'); YEL=$(printf '\033[33m'); PINK=$(printf '\033[95m'); R=$(printf '\033[0m'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty' | sed 's/^Claude //'); ctx_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'if .rate_limits.five_hour then (100 - .rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage) else empty end'); week_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'if .rate_limits.seven_day then (100 - .rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage) else empty end'); out="${CYAN}${model}${R}"; [ -n "$ctx_pct" ] && out="$out  ${YEL}ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$ctx_pct")%${R}"; [ -n "$five_pct" ] && out="$out  ${PINK}5h: $(printf '%.0f' "$five_pct")%${R}"; [ -n "$week_pct" ] && out="$out  ${PINK}7d: $(printf '%.0f' "$week_pct")%${R}"; echo "$out"
